context: Two coworkers review last quarter logistics over coffee
purpose: Teach: 小売/通販/入社/デバイス/インテリア/店内/応答/受け取っ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 先週の小売店の売上、見ました？前期より落ちてますね。
lines.en: Did you see last week's retail store sales? They've dropped compared to last quarter.
lines.style: Calm, slightly concerned female office tone, professional but casual over coffee.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 見ました。逆に通販サイトの方は伸びてるんですよね。
lines.en: I saw it. Conversely, the online shopping site side is actually growing.
lines.style: Thoughtful male voice, measured analytical delivery with a hint of resignation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 去年入社した新人が、その分析レポートまとめてくれましたよ。
lines.en: That new hire who joined the company last year put together the analysis report.
lines.style: Mildly impressed female tone, warm acknowledgment of a junior colleague's effort.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ああ、モバイルデバイス経由の注文が急増してるってやつですよね。
lines.en: Ah, the one showing mobile device orders are surging, right?
lines.style: Recognition lighting up his voice, engaged professional male delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: そうそう。あと店内のインテリアも古くなってて、客足が遠のいてるって。
lines.en: Exactly. Also the in-store interior has gotten old, which is keeping customers away.
lines.style: Slightly worried female voice, sharing concerns conversationally with a sigh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 問い合わせへの応答も遅れてて、苦情も増えてるみたいで。
lines.en: Response times to inquiries have been slow too, and complaints seem to be increasing.
lines.style: Somewhat troubled male tone, lowering voice as he discusses problems.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 昨日、部長から改善提案の依頼メール受け取ったんですけど、一緒に考えません？
lines.en: Yesterday I received an email from the director requesting improvement proposals — want to think together?
lines.style: Collaborative female voice, inviting tone with a touch of camaraderie.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: いいですね。今日の午後、会議室押さえておきますよ。
lines.en: Sounds good. I'll go reserve a meeting room for this afternoon.
lines.style: Agreeable male voice, decisive and helpful workplace tone, ending warmly.
